inputRows.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a clean transparent light-surface proposal treatment based on this actual sourced RA MOTOR GROUP identity. Preserve recognizable slanted RA letter shapes, the simple low coupe outline and the black/gold/silver identity. Wide horizontal arrangement: an isolated compact RA monogram with simplified coupe roof silhouette above it at LEFT, then a generous transparent gap, at RIGHT exact text RA on top and MOTOR GROUP beneath in bold slanted geometric lettering. Make this a flat print-like small-screen treatment with deep charcoal #151b21 and deep bronze-gold #80601e, no metallic gradients; all large ink must contrast on white. Open counters and clean silhouette. No badge background plate or filled tile; car windows, gaps, RA counter and background genuinely transparent. No extra wording, no LTD, no manufacturer badge, no wheels/detail clutter. Strong strokes, legible at120/180px and isolated emblem at32/64px. Transparent margins. No glow, shadow, white keyline, halos, texture or speckles. A proposed treatment of the retained source logo, never claim dealer adoption.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE COMPACT SQUARE MONOGRAM of exactly TWO letters stacked vertically: R ABOVE A. R on upper half, A on lower half, aligned on same central axis; letters touch at one angular shared junction but remain individually readable. Visible design naturally approximately square, not a horizontal word. Bold slanted geometric letterforms with substantial strokes, open R bowl and open triangular A counter. Upper R solid deep charcoal #151b21, lower A solid deep bronze-gold #80601e. Flat opaque ink, truly transparent canvas and counters, generous transparent margin. No car, no vehicle roof, no surroundingplate/frame/shield/circle, no extra letters or wording. Crisp simple initials for RA Motor Group small favicon at32/64px. No gradients, glow, shadow, white keyline, bevel, metallic texture, speckles or fuzzy alpha. Independent compact companion proposal to retained RA branding, not an official/adopted logo.

Exact text RA MOTOR GROUP only, same identity; retained original is separate, this treatment remains unapproved proposal.
